subject: District Accountability Rating Upgrade to Level Two
overview: The committee accepted fiscal reports for 2016 and 2017 and discussed state assessment results showing the district's move to Level 2 status. Members also addressed student transportation initiatives and selected delegates for the annual MASC fall conference.

items.title: FY 2016 Financial Report
items.summary: Accepted the final summary for fiscal year 2016, which concluded with a $100,145 encumbrance and utility costs reflecting higher electricity usage but lower natural gas costs due to a warm winter.

items.title: Elementary Vocational Field Trips
items.summary: Approved a motion for the superintendent to report on the feasibility and cost of providing transportation for elementary students to visit vocational programs at the high school.

items.title: Middle School MBTA S-Passes
items.summary: Referred a request to the superintendent to investigate providing discounted MBTA S-passes to middle school students following parent inquiries.

items.title: FY 2017 Financial Update
items.summary: Placed on file an update regarding the current fiscal year budget, including reports on homeless student transportation, new online payment systems, and bus route safety adjustments.

items.title: MCAS/PARCC Results and Accountability Ratings
items.summary: Reviewed preliminary data showing the district moved from Level 3 to Level 2 and referred the detailed analysis to the Curriculum Subcommittee. Discussion focused on how low participation rates in specific subgroups, particularly English Language Learners at the high school, can negatively impact accountability scores despite academic achievement.

items.title: MCAS Preparation Program Cost Analysis
items.summary: Approved a request for the superintendent to provide a cost report for implementing a six-week MCAS preparation program to replace lost state grant funding.

items.title: MASC Fall Conference Delegates
items.summary: Selected Robert Skerry as delegate and Paulette Van der Kloot as alternate for the MASC fall conference and requested a report on total estimated attendance costs.

items.title: Condolences for Frank Andre
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for Frank Andre, a longtime civic figure and youth baseball coach in the community.
